column1: # [FABLE-5] sq-hmd7l.29 — Geographica real-world family DETERMINISTIC golden COUNTS
# over the PINNED merged LGD/GeoNames corpus (bench/geo/geographica.sh, merged
# 563 885 triples, 21 990 GeoNames POINT + 12 097 LGD wktLiterals).
# Format: <workload>\t<count>.
# COUNTS-NOT-COORDINATES: floating-point geometry is NOT bit-stable, so only
# result-set SIZES are pinned — never a coordinate value. Every count below was
# DERIVED BY RUNNING (not guessed) BOTH engines on the pinned corpus at pin
# time — sparq (bench_geo query, in-process geof: registry) and
# jena-fuseki-geosparql 5.4.0 (HTTP replay of the same pinned .rq files) —
# with EXACT agreement on every bounded workload. Internal consistency also
# holds: q13 + q16 = 21 990 (within + disjoint partition the GeoNames points;
# zero boundary cases) and q09 = 12 097 − q17 (intersects is the complement of
# disjoint over the LGD geometries).
# scripts/bench/geo-same-box.sh (GEO_GEOGRAPHICA=1) cross-checks sparq's live
# counts against this file (drift => timing WITHHELD, recorded as a result)
# and jena's live counts against sparq's. This file is an ORACLE for the
# opt-in comparison family only — the hard per-commit gate stays
# bench/geo/expected.tsv + bench/geo/run.sh.
# q19_join_intersects_geonames_lgd (the ~21 990 x 12 097 naive cross-product
# spatial join): count 0 pinned from a SINGLE-ENGINE derivation — sparq's run
# completed well past the default per-workload cap (roughly 10x over it on the
# pin-time box); jena-fuseki-geosparql did NOT complete inside a ~2x-cap probe
# (no indexed spatial-join path on either side), so its cross-check is PENDING
# a long-cap run. 0 is the geometrically expected value (a POINT intersects a
# LINESTRING only when it lies exactly on it in float space) and the join path
# itself is validated non-vacuously: a synthetic corpus with a GeoNames-
# predicate point placed exactly on an LGD linestring vertex yields count 1
# through the same pinned query. At default caps both engines record honest
# ERROR(timeout) rows — that absence of an indexed path IS the comparative
# result (the jena cross-check + indexed-join follow-up is bead sq-xcly5).
